'''Kristoff Stonelaw''' was a resident of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]], the son of [[Arn Stonelaw|Arn]] and [[Emmi Stonelaw]], the brother of [[Yuri Stonelaw]], and foster brother of [[Mair Koda]]. When the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] arrived on Vernet and built a [[Vernet Imperial Army Training Camp|base]] on the planet, Kristoff was conscripted and began training as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]]. During his training, Kristoff was indoctrinated into believing the Empire's propaganda, mainly through drugged food and subliminal messaging. When Mair Koda and Yuri attempted to rescue him, they found Kristoff to be unwilling to leave and even willing to turn his own brother in to his [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]]. Koda and Yuri were forced to flee Vernet after their failed attempt to rescue their brother.<ref name="TD" />
